notes: Clean auto-captions, one line per caption, no rolling duplication. All 18 chapters read. Unit stats come from several tiers: hp/damage/armor fields take the first tier read (Hardened Pikeman and Cateran in Feudal, Gallowglass in Castle); later tiers are in unmappedFacts. Concatenated cost pairs ('7525', '1480', '9020') are split food/gold and marked inferred. The tech names Lion's Duty, Clan Traditions and Feuds Aside are never spoken; they are matched to checklist descriptions by effect text (inferred). Tech ages are the age the speaker was in when the tech appeared (inferred). Discounted Mustering Hall prices (375) are kept out of the cost fields; only full-price ones (1,200 and 2,400 food, no Highland landmark) are filled, as inferred. Speeds are spoken without the decimal point ('169' = 1.69).
